title: Stripe Kinetic Mesh Ribbon
subtitle: Bézier Streamline Manifolds & Spectral Interpolation
description: The iconic Stripe animated background element formulated through sweeping Bézier ribbon manifolds, 3D harmonic traveling wave fluting, and continuous 5-stop spectral color interpolation (Cyan, Indigo, Magenta, Orange, Amber) rendered across hundreds of brushed-silk streamlines.
mathNotation: \mathbf{R}(u, v, t) = \mathbf{B}(u, t) + \mathbf{n}(u, t) \cdot \left( v \frac{w(u)}{2} + \sum_{i=1}^2 A_i \sin(m_i u + \omega_i t + \phi_v) \right), \quad C(\xi) = \operatorname{SplineColormap}(\xi)
formulaCompact: R(u, v, t) = B(u) + n(u) * (v * w(u)*0.5 + sin(12u + phi + 1.5t)*3.5), \quad C = LerpPalette((0.45v + 0.15t) \bmod 1)
